name: model-router
description: Routes every Claude Code turn to the cheapest model that can do it well (Haiku lookups, Sonnet execution, Opus decisions), lets the model escalate itself, routes subagents too, keeps a warm cache when switching would cost more, and shows how much you saved vs all-Opus. Classification runs on your own Anthropic account; no third party sees your prompts.

language.title: Reason language
language.description: Language of the routing reason and the savings line in the band (en = English, zh = Simplified Chinese)

reviewModel.title: Decision reviewer
reviewModel.description: Reviews Opus's decisions, only if this model exists on your account (checked daily). Fable 5.1 is never used.
